body:
Hi Mitch,

I was on the L&M site and the first thing I saw was the page title: it spells the state 'Arizonia'. Small typo, big first impression. The testimonials on the homepage are all about three years old too, and the footer still says 2024, so a family business running since 2006 ends up looking like it quietly closed down.

That gap between the real business and the website is exactly what I fix.

So I went ahead and redesigned the L&M homepage, and it is attached to this email as a PDF. The typo is gone, your number sits at the top where people actually look, and you and Devin are front and center, because the family story is the strongest thing you have going.

I build sites for pest control companies. Eco La Termite (ecolatermite.com) is one of mine, clean service pages with current proof throughout. I also worked on Find Pest Pros (orkin.findpestpros.com), a pest control directory built so homeowners can find and contact a local company fast.

Take a look at the PDF and tell me what you think. If you like the direction, I can build it on lmpestcontrol.com for real. If not, keep it as free ideas, no hard feelings.

Best,
Hassan
name: L&M Pest Control (L&M Pest and Weed Control)
subject: 🐜 Mitch, your site spells it Arizonia
